title: Zesty Juicy Turkish Lamb Kebabs
description: A salty and juicy Turkish dish featuring lamb, sea salt, and a mirepoix base, perfect for kids and Buddhist temple friendly.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together sea salt, black pepper, and olive oil.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Grill the kebabs for 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked through.
While the kebabs are cooking, heat the lemon juice in a small saucepan over low heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery to the saucepan and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Serve the kebabs with the mirepoix sauce spooned over the top.
